Each identity must spend unmatchable human hours reviewing a pearl of prior work before issuing new tasks, with reviewers randomly assigned and paid only in future queue priority. The system records review latency and agreement variance; an attacker fabricating identities must sit through this shale of tedious grading themselves or hire real people, costing roughly forty human-hours per identity before any economic action. Faking the ivory of consistent judgment across many sockpuppets then requires sustained cognitive labor that no scripted farm can supply.
